# Case 1: no edges in the cluster
{"directed":[[0,0,0],[0,0,0],[0,0,0]],"nodes":[0,1,2],"partition":[0,0,0],"gamma":0.5}
@ no edges → kCluster = 0 and all kNode = 0 → ev = 0 and threshold = 0 → no nodes are well-connected
{"connected":[]}


# Case 2: same chain but very large gamma → no nodes well-connected
{"directed":[[0,1,0],[1,0,1],[0,1,0]],"nodes":[0,1,2],"partition":[0,0,0],"gamma":10.0}
@ gamma >> kCluster → thresholds are positive and ≥ ev for each node → no nodes are well-connected
{"connected":[]}

# Case 3: single-node cluster
{"directed":[[0]],"nodes":[0],"partition":[0],"gamma":0.5}
@ S has only one node; ev is 0 and threshold is 0 → strict inequality ev > threshold fails → no nodes are well-connected
{"connected":[]}
